label: my-PV AC•THOR – Opportunity Loads
info:
My-PV AC-Thor using s2-resource's built-in D-Bus transport. Set the device IP in the inject node before deploying.

**My-PV device setup (required):** in the My-PV web interface, go to Device Setup > Control settings and set the control type to **HTTP**. This flow drives the device purely through its `/control.html?power=` and reads `/data.jsn`, `/setup.jsn` HTTP endpoints - those only accept external setpoints while HTTP Control is selected; any other control mode (e.g. PV/Loop control) will ignore the power values this flow sends.

**Assumed device:** this flow assumes a My-PV AC-Thor 9s with three 3000 W heating elements (one per phase, 9 kW total), matching the `s2-resource` node's System Description (four operation modes: Off, and L1/L1+L2/L1+L2+L3 on at up to 3000 W each) and the D-Bus config's 3-phase L1_L2_L3 measurement.

This flow has only been tested with the device's device mode "1: Hot water 9 kW" - not with Boost mode or legionella protection interaction, so behavior with those features active is unverified.

To adapt this for a different My-PV model or wiring (e.g. a single-phase AC-Thor, or different element wattages):
- Open the `s2-resource` node's Control Type tab and edit the System Description's operation modes/power ranges to match your device's actual heating-element wattage(s) and phase wiring.
- Open the `mypv-dbus-config` node and adjust `nrOfPhases`/`phaseSetting`/`measurementType` to match how the device is actually wired (single-phase vs. 3-phase).

**Status label language:** the "Retrieve data" function node's `LANGUAGE_CODE` constant controls which language the Status indicator's labels are shown in (defaults to `en`); change it to `de`, `es`, `fr`, `it`, or `nl` for the other supported languages.
